lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in equidistant horizontal and vertical rows posterior to the visible gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting the circular high-luminance blobs to form a distinct grid-like matrix across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light on the superior surface and shadow on the inferior surface.
